They just found him in a park across town.|ISB Supervisor Avril Heert informs Major Partagaz of Lonni Jung's death at the park|}} A '''park''' existed in [[Imperial City]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. After being informed [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] was close to fully uncovering the [[Axis network]] in [[1 BBY]], [[Lonni Jung]], an Axis network mole in the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], met with [[Luthen Rael]] at the park after going through Meero's [[Code cylinder]]. During the interaction, Jung exposed the information he had discovered on [[Project Celestial Power]] while attempting to seek safety for his family. Shortly after revealing the truth existence of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] to Luthen, the spymaster shot and [[death|killed]] Jung, leaving his body on a bench in the park. Not long after the interaction, members of the [[Galactic Empire]] discovered Jung's body was in the park, informing ISB Supervisor [[Avril Heert]] of the discovery, who then promptly informed [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]]. {{Loc-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The park first appeared in "[[Make It Stop]]," the tenth episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']].{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Parks and gardens]] [[Category:Coruscant locations]]
